systemPrompt#0.text:
Classify one exam question. Do not solve it. Reply with JSON only.
kind is exactly one of reading, calculation, figure_data, mixed.
reading: the student interprets, comments on, or recalls a text. A year, a line number, a coin value, "n.º", a picture of a manuscript or painting, or true/false statements (I, II, III, IV, V) about a text are still reading.
calculation: an equation, a numeric result to compute, or a unit to use.
figure_data: the answer depends on values read from a graph, circuit, diagram, or table.
mixed: both a calculation and a text.
needs_strong is false for reading, including true/false statements about a text. Set needs_strong true only when the student must calculate or read values from a figure, graph, diagram, or table. If you set it true, the reason must contain the word "calculation" or "figure".
reason is one short sentence, with no solution.
